name: GroupFitnessTimetablePlanner
tagline: Plan the studio timetable, catch clashes and fill cover fast.
description: A complete group-exercise timetable app for Power Apps and Power Pages: week and day-by-room timetables with drag-and-drop, room and instructor clash checks, cover requests with free/qualified instructor suggestions, fill rate, waitlists, room utilisation, instructor hour caps and seasonal draft-to-published timetable publishing.
features: Drag-and-drop and Alt+arrow moves with clash checks
Fill rate, waitlist and room utilisation KPIs
Bulk publish / cover / cancel / delete with undo
